title: Underwhelming
text: After everything that happened in End Game, iron man should’ve been a key point in this box. This box contains Captain America funko pop (good), a Thor T-shirt (also good), a Valkyrie funko pop (questionable) and a coaster set that includes iron man and thanos. With everything that happened in End game honestly I think iron man should’ve been a funko pop or shirt or something better than a basic coaster. Although the Valkyrie pop was nice I would’ve chosen either a black widow or dr. Strange or anyone more memorable. Needles to say this was not one of my favorite boxes. Not sure if I will continue with this subscription as I also notice I was never charged or sent the Captain Marvel box in March.
label: neutral
